worldcombat.skill.foresight.summary: See a foe through: leave a foresight mark that strips its current evasion and lights it up; inside the mark a Ghost's form is made solid, so Normal and Fighting attacks connect, and the moment it turns solid bursts with a real-shadow flash.
worldcombat.skill.foresight.use.0: break a Ghost's immunity before your normal hit
worldcombat.skill.foresight.use.2: set up a Normal or Fighting hit for an ally
Strip %1$s stages of the target's positive evasion (capped by what it actually has) and light it up for %2$s: while marked, Normal and Fighting moves connect on a Ghost and its form is made solid.
Inside the mark the target is lit up for %1$s, visible even through cover.
worldcombat.skill.foresight.deep.on: Deep sight: %1$s wind-up and %2$s cooldown buy a longer window and reveal.
worldcombat.skill.foresight.deep.off: Quick sight: shorter window, faster wind-up and cooldown, good for breaking immunity often.
Sight range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s; a blocked line of sight or a target already foreseen refuses the cast.
worldcombat.skill.foresight.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.foresight.preference.d: Deep sight: window x1.6, reveal x1.4, denser gaze, but +3 wind-up and +18 cooldown; off is a shorter but faster, cheaper cast.
worldcombat.skill.foresight.preference.a: The companion only considers foresight within this distance of a threat; lower stays in melee, higher chases further.
When on, it will leave its post to cast foresight.
world_combat.move.foresight.text.read: Foreseen (%1$s s of a solid form)
When the window runs out or the mark is removed, the stripped evasion is returned as it was and the mark fades; a new casting returns the previous strip first, so the same evasion is never deducted and restored twice over.
